description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a restoring law and order press conference alongside local elected leaders and local law enforcement officials to discuss how Governor Roy Cooper 40 years of being soft on crime culminating in his tragic decision to give 4,200 convicted criminals, including violent offenders who lit their neighbor on fire and watched him burn to death, a get out of jail free card. And the law enforcement folks discussed why pretty much every major law enforcement organization in NC has endorsed Michael Whatley over a former Attorney General.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts Restoring Law and Order Press Conference in Johnston County – Michael Whatley for Senate
